content:
Context: 9. Gratuity

The employee may specify the person(s) to whom the right  
conferred on nominee(s) shall pass in the event of death of the nominee(s).  
The employee may provide in the nomination the contingency on the  
happening of which the nomination will become invalid.  
In such a case, the employee should furnish fresh nomination without delay after the occurrence of the specified contingency. - Rule 46.
